pr.title: Optimize generation: host-side sampling with pinned staging
pr.body: Optimize generation: host-side sampling with pinned staging ("~2x faster generation"). Avoids device RNG divergence across GPU architectures, removes the sampling kernel launch from the hot loop, and adds a numerical stability guard. Outputs are bit-identical.
pr.head: 9c2b11d0

triage.note: per-token DtoH transfer in the hot loop
isfinite().all().item() forces a full device sync every generated token
